messages:
mari: ok team, tradition time — who wants to be the next Biscuit Scepter Holder? :crown: 

devon: wait is this the one where you have to bring biscuits to Standup for two weeks? :eyes:

sasha: yes. and you must perform the morning biscuit blessing.

jules: reminder: last holder (laura) hid the scepter in the plant pot. chaotic neutral move. :seedling:

laura: i regret nothing. the ficus needed character. :smirk: 

dmitri: nominating @devon because he always answers Slack at 3AM and clearly has the endurance. :raised_hands:

devon: honored. low-key terrified. what are the official duties exactly?

mari: duties documented in the sacred README (verbatim):
```
BISCUIT SCEPTER CODE OF CONDUCT v1.0
- Bring biscuits to team standup at least 3x/week
- Protect scepter from coffee spills
- Deliver one ritual anecdote per possession period
- Keep it on your desk unless on a mission
```

sasha: also you must accept sticker-bot's blessing.

sticker-bot: :sparkles: Congratulatory sticker sent to devon :sparkles:

jules: vote with emoji? :+1: to accept, :-1: to forfeit, :banana: for chaos.

laura: :+1: (would like more biscuit variety in the office fridge while I'm here)

dmitri: :banana: obviously.

sasha: :+1:

mari: :+1: 

devon: wow majority. i'm in. will assume scepter and responsibility.

devon: quick question — where is the scepter currently? last i heard it was under a pile of post-it notes.

mari: it is currently under the small succulent by the blue lamp. approach with caution, it is crumbly. :laughing:

devon: on my way to rescue it. standup will be very ceremonial today. maybe bring cameras? :camera_with_flash:

ops-bot: Reminder: physical-object rituals are non-workplay and should not interfere with SLAs. Also: please do not leave food near servers. :robot_face:

laura: i'll bring the biscuits (chocolate chip & one gluten-free option). devon you better not lose it.

jules: if devon loses it, it's a 3-song karaoke penance.

mari: official log entry (for posterity): "2123456789 — Biscuit Scepter transferred to devon. May his biscuits be warm." :scroll:

sasha: legendary. can we get an office photo to add to the lore archive?

devon: yes, will post pic after standup. expect dramatic lighting. :studio_light:

mari: and we shall never speak of the Ficus Incident of '24 again.

sticker-bot: Sticker update: Biscuit Scepter sticker added to #lore-cabinet :tada:
